# Third-Party Dependencies

This directory contains dependency source trees and provenance records that are
required to reproduce the Procurator artifact but are not first-party
Procurator or P4B source code. The P4B/p4c fork lives under `src/p4b/source/`.

- `ultimate/`: the pinned Ultimate/GemCutter source tree or artifact-provided
  binary bundle.
- `z3/`: solver provenance placeholder; the artifact environment may provide
  the actual binary.

See `third_party/MANIFEST.json` and `THIRD_PARTY.md` for license and provenance
tracking.
